items.title: 🎭 Campaigns you can switch between
items.body: Campaign folders in the Lore Library now have a ▶ play button. Press it to make that campaign active, and your whole setup swaps at once: every character changes to their version for that campaign — portrait, description, relationship and all — the lorebooks filed under that campaign turn on, and the previous campaign's books turn off. Books you turned on yourself are left alone, and you can mark a book as global (the globe icon) so it stays on in every campaign. The button turns into a ✓ while a campaign is active; press it again to turn the campaign off, and everything works just like before.

items.title: 👥 One character, many versions
items.body: A character can now have a different version for each campaign, so the same cast can show up in different settings without making duplicate cards. Every character starts with a Base version. Tap the + on their card to add a version for a campaign — it copies whichever version you're looking at — then change whatever you like. It's used automatically whenever that campaign is active, and anything you change during play is saved to it for you. If you don't use campaigns, nothing changes: versions only appear once a campaign exists.

items.title: 🖼️ A redesigned Character Workshop
items.body: The portrait now fills the whole left side of the Workshop, with the character's name, relationship and versions shown over it, and the editing tabs on the right. Switching between versions fades smoothly from one portrait to the next. Everything you could do before is still there. On a phone, the portrait becomes a banner above the editor.

items.title: 📇 The Roster shows which campaign you're in
items.body: The Character Roster now says which campaign you're looking at and marks characters that have more than one version, so you can tell at a glance which one you're about to edit.

items.title: 📚 Lorebooks that follow your characters
items.body: A lorebook with exactly the same name as a character now turns on by itself while that character is in the chat, and off again when they leave. It only ever turns off books it turned on, so books you switched on yourself are never touched. Don't want it? Settings → Lore Library → Auto-link books by character name.

items.title: 🔧 Fixes
items.body: Right-click menus in the Lore Library no longer run off the edge of the screen. Moving several books at once on a phone no longer drops an empty entry into the folder. And the 'add a campaign version' menu is no longer cut off on phones.
